meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,执行计划时 Claude 会变总指挥,把工作分成多个阶段派给子代理,自己只协调和验收。子代理必须照文档做,不凭空猜 API。每个阶段后另派子代理验证、扫查坏模式、审代码,通过才提交。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行、运行或实施一个计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.note: Claude 会把它分成阶段,逐个派子代理完成并验收。

say.text: 运行 make-plan 生成的那份计划。
say.note: 它会照计划分阶段推进,验证通过后才会提交。

say.text: 把这份计划落地,每完成一步先验证再继续。
say.note: 这样不会跳过验证,也不会在通过前提交改动。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude executes a plan as an orchestrator: subagents do all phases, while Claude only coordinates and verifies. They follow docs, never invent APIs. Extra subagents validate and review code per phase; commit only when verified.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one generated by make-plan.

say_en.note: Claude delegates it to subagents and verifies each phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan that make-plan generated.
say_en.note: It executes it phase by phase and commits after verification.

say_en.text: Carry out this plan step by step, verifying before continuing.
say_en.note: This avoids skipping phases and committing early.
